text:
emma: Publish window open for Py + TS SDKs. Quick read: canaries are live, want a fast pre-cut sweep. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canaries deployed: py-canary-2026-03-21-1, ts-canary-2026-03-21-1. CI: https://ci/internal/6721
raj: Rollback triggers reminder: >0.5% client error rate increase, any signer/checksum mismatch on pip/npm artifacts, or critical runtime type break in TS. If triggered, pin `latest` back to previous stable and open rollback PR.
marta: Note: typedef generator has caused regressions before — check `ClientOptions` shape closely. If types regression occurs, prefer hold+republish rather than immediate GA.
ken: Checklist: (1) publish to staging registry (2) pip/npm smoke installs (3) run sample app smoke (4) check telemetry delta for token errors.
paul: Doing installs now. Py canary installs fine. TS canary install fails with types error for `ClientOptions.timeout` in generated d.ts. Investigating. :mag_right:
emma: If confirmed, we hold GA. No hotfixes mid-window unless release-blocking. Decide in +12m.
sre-oncall: CI queue is backed up; flaky integration tests should be retried once before failing. Incident: https://infra/inc/8892
raj: Rollback plan: pin dist-tag `latest` to `2026-03-19-stable` and create `canary-hold` for investigation. Update release notes to indicate hold reason if we stop the cut.
paul: Found a generator diff regression. I can patch and republish a new canary quickly — prefer republish vs rollback.
emma: Agreed. Republish canary, run smoke and telemetry for 10m, then decide GA.
deploy-bot: py-canary: smoke OK. ts-canary: smoke failed (typedef mismatch).
marta: Hold GA. @paul publish patched canary and post artifact URL. Tag release notes with "hold: TS typedef" and guidance for pinned-type users.
paul: Patched and pushed ts-canary-2026-03-21-2. Artifact: registry.corp/npm/@redwood/sdk/ts-canary-2
ken: Re-running smoke installs and sample-app tests now.
paul: Patched TS canary passes installs and runtime smoke.
raj: Telemetry: no anomalous token/signature errors in 10m after republish. Looks clear.
emma: Preparing GA cut. Please add migration guidance for `ClientOptions.timeout` change and recommend pin strategies (dist-tag stable or explicit ranges).
sre-oncall: No infra alerts. Proceed.
deploy-bot: Starting GA publish: publish-py-2026-03-21, publish-ts-2026-03-21. Logs: https://ci/internal/publish/9812
paul: Request: include short section in release notes about artifact checksum verification steps we ran during the window for customers.
emma: Added verification steps to the release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-21-sdk-release (draft).
raj: Post-GA: create a brief RCA for the typedef regression and add a regression test to the generator. Assigning to @paul and @marta.
paul: Will open PR for generator test and the patch.
marta: Finalizing release notes and will schedule announcement in #announcements at 16:30 UTC. :tada:
emma: Closing thread — monitoring for 30m. Rollback criteria: >1% error increase or any checksum/signature alerts. Reopen if triggered.
deploy-bot: Publish completed: success. Artifacts pinned: py@2026-03-21, ts@2026-03-21. :shipit:
